title: Phone: show the background watchers a computer runs on Computers
body: Follow-up to #10172. The terminal and desktop now show `N background watcher(s) · disk cleanup` at startup. The phone's Computers list (`crates/openagents-mobile/src/computers_home.rs`) shows each computer's status ("Online") but has no background data: it would need a NIP-HOST `background.list` read (observe right) per online computer in `coder-mobile`'s snapshot, parsed into names, then the same line from `openagents_chat_app::watchers::line` under the computer's status. Larger than the startup line, so tracked separately.
